html:
SMTO-RST-0006 — SMTO stopped an action that didn't match its earlier record

GUID: 9ac00db8-078b-4a13-9210-d3332453ce89
Slug: run-call-identity-reused
Domain: RST · Subsystem: rst

What happened

  • The Agent tried to run an action under the same record as an earlier one, but with different details. SMTO stopped it so the earlier result isn't mixed up with new work.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the conversation's activity and find the earlier action; check whether it finished and what it reported. SMTO kept the earlier action's result, so you can see whether it already took effect.
  2. If that action changed something outside SMTO, such as a file, a message or another system, check that place directly. This tells you whether doing it again would make the same change twice.
  3. If it still needs doing, ask for it in a new message with the details you want. A new request gets its own record, so it isn't confused with the earlier one.

What success looks like

  • The new request runs once without this error, and the earlier result is unchanged.

If it still fails

  • Check whether the earlier action already happened before you try anything again. Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't ask SMTO to redo finished changes just to clear this message.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A tool call reused a saved call ID whose normalized call identity, arguments or direct_completion metadata differ from the stored record, so the claim was rejected.

What this means

  • Reusing a saved call ID changes its normalized call identity/arguments or direct_completion metadata. State diagnostics preserve authoritative journal, ownership and effect evidence. They do not delete records, loosen ownership fences, issue SQL or restart/replay work; missing persistence confirmation is separate from in-memory acceptance.

Why this can happen

  • Reusing a saved call ID changes its normalized call identity/arguments or direct_completion metadata.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the original claim and new envelope before assigning or replaying any effectful operation.

How to fix it

  • MemoryRunStore.claim / RunStore.claim raised ReusedCallMismatch for a native_receipts call_id. Keep the original receipt and reconcile the current run; issue changed work under a new call identity and do not replay completed mutations to repair metadata.
  • Keep the original receipt and reconcile the current run. Do not reuse an operation identity for changed work or replay completed mutations to repair metadata.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • The original receipt remains tied to its unchanged operation identity and new work is explicit.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • State diagnostics preserve authoritative journal, ownership and effect evidence. They do not delete records, loosen ownership fences, issue SQL or restart/replay work; missing persistence confirmation is separate from in-memory acceptance.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-EXE-0004 — Execution outcome is unknown
